name: Dream Vacation Debate
description: Teams pitch their ultimate group vacation. Rank destinations, split into teams, relay-write a pitch, then wager on the winner!

submit-destinations.prompt: Where's your dream vacation destination? (City, country, or place)

rank-destinations.prompt: Rank these destinations from BEST to WORST

top-destination.message:
The class has spoken! Here are the rankings:

{{rank-destinations.rankedList}}

team-intro.message:
Teams are set! Now everyone will take turns building a vacation pitch — one sentence at a time.

Make it the trip of a lifetime!

write-pitch.prompt: Add the next sentence to the group vacation pitch. Make it exciting and build on what came before!

pitch-reveal.message:
The vacation pitch is complete! Here's what the class came up with:

{{write-pitch.text}}

place-bets.prompt: Which team contributed more to the pitch? Who deserves the booking?

end.message: Thanks for playing Dream Vacation Debate! Start packing!
